metadata.short_desc: Distill chats into first-person long-term memories, with an embedding console.
metadata.desc: Distill chats into the bot's first-person long-term memories and write them into an AstrBot knowledge base. Three layers (state / preference / event), confidence, cosine dedupe and source validation. Includes an Embedding Console view.

cloud_api_base.hint: For example https://api.openai.com/v1. /v1 is normalized automatically.

cloud_api_key.hint: Stored locally and never echoed by the console API.

local_host.hint: In Docker, 127.0.0.1 is the AstrBot container itself.

embedding-console.title: Embedding Console
embedding-console.description: Configure the embedding used by the memory layer: a cloud API or a local listening port.
embedding-console.subtitle: Pick an embedding source, test connectivity, then save and bind it to the memory knowledge base.
embedding-console.mode_kb_hint: Leave the knowledge base embedding provider untouched and use whatever is configured there.
embedding-console.dimensions_hint: 0 or empty means auto-detect on save.
embedding-console.key_placeholder: Leave empty to keep the saved key
embedding-console.key_saved: Saved ({mask}); leave empty to keep it
embedding-console.create_kb: Create the knowledge base if it does not exist
embedding-console.force: I understand existing memories may become unsearchable; switch embedding model anyway (same dimensions)
embedding-console.force_hint: Only needed when the model changes and dimensions match. Dimension changes are always rejected.
embedding-console.log_ready: Test connectivity first, then save. Saving creates or updates the AstrBot embedding provider and binds the memory knowledge base to it.
embedding-console.local_hint: In Docker, 127.0.0.1 is the AstrBot container itself. For a host service, use host.docker.internal; if that name is unavailable, check the Docker bridge address with ip route.
embedding-console.api_key_note: The key is written only to the local AstrBot config and is never echoed by the API.
